106:1.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh

106:2.text: the caravan of winter and summer

106:3.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

106:4.text: from hunger and made them safe,

107:1.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

107:2.text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

107:3.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

107:4.text: So woe to those who pray

107:5.text: who are heedless of their prayer

108:2.text: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice

108:3.text: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
